title: Mystical Meals
description: Mystical Meals is a mod that adds 15 new foods and drinks to your Minecraft world with some special effects when consumed.
body:
![The logo of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7597daea214fdf8dc4dadea6e0ec06c3c348231.png)
Mystical Meals is a mod that adds 15 new foods and drinks to your Minecraft world with some special effects when consumed!

They include:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![An infographic containing all items included in the mod and the effects they give.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69f2f330bfd8c7442cf6bb4e433ffa2a01fa65d9.png)

</details>

These items can currently only be crafted using their respective recipes. Implementation within Vanilla loot tables is planned.

### Credits
Certain sprites used in this mod were originally created by other people with permission explicitly stated in the projects:
- Wisp Waffle was created by [Henry Software](https://henrysoftware.itch.io/pixel-food)
- Pixie Puff was created by [nnekart](https://nnekart.itch.io/candy-collectible-icon)
- Frosted Fungus was created by [keifoopx](https://keifoopx.itch.io/99-various-ingredients)
- Enchanted Eclair and Dreamy Donut were created by [jennpixel](https://jennpixel.itch.io/free-dessert-pack-12-icons)
- Blightberry Jam, Glimmer Gourd, and Cinder Citrus were created by [alexkovacsart](https://alexkovacsart.itch.io/free-pixel-art-foods)

# Notice: This mod requires Fabric API!
